name: woohyuk-coding-plugin
description: Personal Codex workflows and specialized subagents for review, design implementation, documentation, implementation planning and execution, PRs, testing, release checks, commit messages, and LLM wiki lookup.

interface.shortDescription: Specialized agents for review, design, plans, code, tests, and docs.
interface.longDescription: Woohyuk Coding Plugin provides specialized architect, implementer, reviewer, and tester subagents plus personal Codex skills for reviewing code, creating interactive HTML diff explanations, using Pencil .pen design files, maintaining README files, documenting project architecture, writing ADRs, creating one active subgoal-based implementation plan, executing and independently testing it with Ralph, planning tests, running visual QA, checking public release readiness, drafting commit messages, preparing PR content, updating changelogs, checking documentation consistency, and searching the local LLM wiki.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use specialized subagents for planning, implementation, review, testing, documentation, and release workflows.
